phases.name: Content Rehabilitation

phases.summary: Mandatory human review interface for sensitive topics (crime, fatalities, politics, health, financial markets) before publishing.

phases.name: Technical Validation & Performance

phases.summary: Audit rendering speed, mobile responsiveness, structured data compliance, and RSS/sitemap feeds.

phases.name: Final AdSense Readiness Audit
phases.summary: Final compliance verification against Google AdSense Low-Value Content policies before re-application.

sensitiveCategories.name: Crime / Legal
